title: Synthetic reviewed scenario: replacement effect choice
question: Two replacement effects would exile a card instead of putting it into a graveyard. Who chooses between them?

cards.name: Rest in Peace
cards.oracleText: If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

cards.name: Leyline of the Void
cards.oracleText: If a card would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

rules.text: The affected object's controller or owner, or the affected player, chooses among applicable replacement and prevention effects.

modelOutput.summary: The affected object's controller or owner, or the affected player, chooses which applicable replacement effect to apply.

reasoningSteps.text: When multiple replacement effects modify the same event, the affected object's controller or owner, or the affected player, chooses one to apply.
